scores.notes: Alice in both is a young girl with long straight light-brown hair, fair skin and a round face, in a yellow puff-sleeved dress with white pinafore and blue-striped stockings.
Alice in both is a fair young girl with long light-brown hair, yellow puff-sleeved dress, white pinafore and blue-striped stockings (left holding the flamingo, right seated at the table).

Both show a striped mown lawn bounded by clipped rounded hedges with giant mushrooms and woodland behind, with hedgehogs and a flamingo; hoops are striped arches on the left and card arches on the right and the light is warmer on the right, but the ground itself matches.

Alice at the tea table (left) and holding the bottle in the hall (right) is a fair-skinned girl of about eight with wavy brown hair and a round face; her hair reads a little darker and shorter in the dim hall, which the lighting explains.

Alice holding the bottle (left) and swinging the flamingo (right) is a fair round-faced girl of about eight with wavy brown hair; it looks lighter and longer in the sunlit right image, which lighting accounts for.
The Cheshire Cat on the branch (left, whole body) and as a floating head (right) is the same grey tabby with dark stripes, pale muzzle, pink nose and wide toothy grin.

Left has a long table covered in a creased cloth with a tan stone gabled house with tall chimneys set far back; right has a bare plank table with no cloth and a red-brick, timber-porched cottage with leaded windows right behind it. Big oak and lawn match, but table covering and house conflict.

Alice facing the Caterpillar (left) and seated at the tea table (right) is a fair round-faced girl of about eight with long wavy brown hair; it reads darker in the dim forest and lighter in sunlight, with no conflicting cue.

Alice in both is a young girl with long straight light-brown hair, fair skin and a round face, wearing the yellow dress, white pinafore, blue sash and striped stockings; smaller on the right but hair and face match.

Alice in both is a small girl with long straight light-brown hair and fair skin in a pale yellow dress with white pinafore and striped stockings; on the right she is small and in profile, but hair, age and build agree.

Alice in both has long straight light-brown hair, fair skin, a child's slight build and the yellow dress with pinafore, blue sash and striped stockings; the left is a small profile view but nothing conflicts.

Both show a long white-clothed tea table on a lawn beneath a big tree with a reddish-brown timbered, gabled English house behind; the house is farther off on the left and close with bay windows on the right, a viewpoint difference rather than a clear conflict.

Both show a long white-clothed tea table on a leaf-strewn lawn under a large tree with a brick-and-half-timber Tudor-style house behind; the house is close with bay windows on the left and farther off with gables on the right, which a different viewpoint could explain.

Alice in both is a slight young girl with long light golden-brown hair in the yellow dress, white pinafore and striped stockings; on the right she is small and seen mostly from behind, so the match rests on hair, age and build.

Alice in both is a young girl with long wavy golden-brown hair, fair skin and a worried round face in the yellow dress, white pinafore, blue sash and striped stockings; smaller on the right but face and hair match.
Alice in both is a girl of the same age with long wavy golden-brown hair held by a blue band, fair rosy skin and a round face, in the yellow dress, white pinafore, blue sash and striped stockings.
Alice in both is a young girl with long straight light-brown hair, fair skin and a round serious face in the yellow dress, white pinafore and striped stockings.

Both have a long tea table under a big oak, but the house behind is a grey stone slate-roofed house on the left and a red-brick, half-timbered tiled cottage with a gabled porch on the right, and the table has a white cloth on the left and bare boards on the right.

Alice by the mushroom (left, small, in profile) and holding the bottle (right) is the same young girl with long straight light-brown hair, fair skin and slight build, in the same yellow dress and striped stockings.

Both show a long cloth-covered tea table with wooden chairs on a lawn under a large spreading oak, with a pale stone country house behind on the left side; the house has more gables on the left but the kind and arrangement of place agree.

Alice by the mushroom (left, small, in profile) and holding the flamingo (right) is the same young girl with long light-brown hair and a headband, fair skin and slight build, in the same yellow dress and striped stockings.

Alice is a young girl with long straight light golden-brown hair and fair skin seated at the table on the left and standing mid-court on the right; on the right she is smaller and partly turned away, but hair colour and length, age and build agree.

Both show a long white-clothed tea table on a lawn in front of a huge tree trunk at centre-right with a multi-gabled timbered house with chimneys set back at the left; the house is browner on the left and more clearly half-timbered on the right, but the layout matches.

Both show a ridged grass lawn enclosed by a low stone garden wall with rounded clipped bushes, tall trees, card-soldier hoops in the distance and large mushrooms at the right edge under the same warm daytime sky; right has more mushrooms and wire hoops but layout is compatible.

Both show a rough grassy lawn bordered by clipped hedges and trees with giant mushrooms rising at the upper right, hedgehogs and card figures on the grass and the same warm daylight; left shows a stone wall and rounded topiary, right taller hedges, which fits another angle on the same garden.

Alice standing before the bench, seen mostly from behind (left, small) and swinging the flamingo (right): both a girl of about ten with long wavy light-brown hair, fair skin, slight build, same yellow dress, white pinafore and striped stockings. Left face is largely turned away, so the match rests on hair, age and build, which agree.

The floating cat head (left) is a warm brown/tawny tabby with yellow-amber eyes; the cat on the branch (right) is a cool grey/silver tabby with green eyes. Both are grinning striped tabbies, but fur colour and eye colour conflict beyond what the lighting change explains (Alice's hair and dress keep their colours).

Both show a sunlit grass croquet lawn enclosed by tall clipped hedges with autumn-tinted trees behind and clusters of large mushrooms at the edge; hoops are card soldiers on the left and plain arches on the right, but the ground itself matches.

Alice is a small girl with long straight light-brown hair, fair skin and the same slight build in both; she is seen partly from behind in the court on the left, so the match rests on hair, age and build rather than the face.

Alice in both is a girl of about eight to ten with long light-brown hair, fair skin and a round face; hair is wavier with a blue band on the left and straighter on the right, but colour, length, age and build agree.
Alice in the courtroom on the left and holding the bottle on the right is the same girl of about nine with long straight light-brown hair, fair skin, a small oval face and slight build.

Both show a daytime ridged croquet lawn bounded by clipped rounded hedges with tall trees and clusters of giant mushrooms beyond; hoops are striped on the left and plain on the right, a minor difference.

Both show a sunlit enclosed ridged lawn with flowering borders, tall trees and mushrooms at the right edge; the left shows a stone garden wall and the right a tall hedge, which fits two sides of one enclosed garden.

Alice carrying the flamingo on the left and holding the bottle on the right is the same girl of about nine with long light-brown hair, fair skin, a small oval face and slight build; hair is wavier on the left.
